title: deepseek user trying claude for my dream game (far cry-ish), lost on models + mcp/3d stuff
author: PsycoPaloza
selftext:
Trying to build my dream game. Not a shooter but I want Far Cry-style graphics.

I've done \~10 projects with deepseek via opencode/openchamber + api. Usual workflow: I plan everything, then tell it to run the plan with subagents and let it go.

Deepseek isn't cutting it on the 3D/visual side.

Someone said try Claude. Never used it, way too many models. Which one do people actually use for game dev/3D? Don't mind paying if it saves time.

Also how do I make my own assets? Keep seeing MCP servers for Blender/3D. How does that actually work — install one and Claude drives Blender? Any specific ones for terrain/trees/rocks/props? Saw Meshy, AGSB3D, StraySpark mentioned but no clue if that's the right start.

Does the "plan then let subagents run" thing even work for game/3D or do I need to babysit more?

Not looking for magic. Just don't want to waste a month on the wrong model/setup.

comments.author: drahgon
comments.body: Gonna be a lot of learning. For 3d and assets there is no competitor right now to opus 5.5 and fable 5.2. Yes install blender and blender MCP just ask you agent to do it for you and then just build small scenes to test out what it can do. You will get feel for it. Don't build the entire game until you are confident you can get the quality you want.

comments.author: Kindly-Sail6260
comments.body: Working on a workflow but I use Opus 5.5 on medium reasoning to plan out my things and send it to opus subagents with a sonnet reviewer to check work after. The usage is basically the same for me on a 20 dollar plan and I’ve been able to make huge strides on it model wise for making games. And I just get tripo for 3d models since I was able to test it out and it’s incredible once you can a texture and PBR clean up in blender. That’s literally all I use.

comments.author: Economy_Bedroom3902
comments.body:
I wouldn't get my hopes up for farcry level of visual quality just by asking "make it look like farcry".

You'll have to learn how to model/texture, and some shader knowledge in order to be able to guide the AI in the right direction at multiple steps along the way.

comments.author: selfish_meme
comments.body: I would use Claude Opus 5.5 give it your plans and ask it to turn it into a game brief and to ask you any questions to fill out the brief into something it could use to build a full game, I think you should use premade free assets wherever possible. You can use Blender/MCP to make simple models and rig them. I think ChatGPT is a lot better at images than Claude
